name: Jilin Sino-Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Jilin Sino-Microelectronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale, packaging, testing, and marketing of discrete semiconductor devices in China and internationally. The company offers metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs), insulated-gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs), IGBT power modules / PIMs and PMs, Schottky barrier diodes (SBDs), fast recovery diodes (FRDs), silicon-controlled rectifiers (SCRs), bipolar junction transistors (BJTs), intelligent power modules (IPMs), and high-voltage rectifier diodes (HVRDs). It also provides wide-bandgap semiconductors, integrated circuits, power electronic products,…
